'
Cos Life Hurts
is the debut
studio album
by Australian pop-rock group
Uncanny X-Men
.
'
Cos Life Hurts
was released in June 1985 and sold over 100,000 copies in Australia. The album peaked at No. 3 in Australia and was certified 2× platinum.
